comments: Visually reviewed against sources-1.png through sources-5.png on 2026-10-15.
Supplemental pieces retained as reviewed proposals; runtime selects existing states only.
geometry: Counter timing remains Duel-owned; blade arc is decorative.
mapping_basis: Inspected source poses and manually measured transparent gutters; runtime names match existing renderer states.

pieces.label: Shallow birth: slim curved teal blade begins at a fixed copper bead.
pieces.name: strike-1

pieces.label: Shallow peak: broad hooked teal wedge with a pale teal inner ridge.
pieces.name: strike-2

pieces.label: Shallow break: wedge splits into several pointed teal fragments with copper flecks.
pieces.name: strike-3

pieces.label: Shallow fade: sparse small fragments around the contact bead.
pieces.name: strike-4

pieces.label: Standard birth: thin wedge on a more upright diagonal.
pieces.name: piece-04

pieces.label: Standard peak: wide teal crescent-wedge, strongest readable silhouette.
pieces.name: piece-05

pieces.label: Standard break: separated angular teal shards and small copper sparks.
pieces.name: piece-06

pieces.label: Standard fade: small fragments tapering away from the registered contact.
pieces.name: piece-07

pieces.label: Steep birth: long, narrow upward slash with a stable copper origin.
pieces.name: piece-08

pieces.label: Steep peak: broadest steep wedge with curved inner teal shading.
pieces.name: piece-09

pieces.label: Steep break: broken wedge fragments and copper specks along the rising path.
pieces.name: piece-10

pieces.label: Steep fade: connected sparse teal fragments and copper bead, refined to register as one crop.
pieces.name: piece-11

size_basis: 32×32; top-left (contact x-20,130-16), intentionally offset from the other bursts.

source_preparation.warm_effect_grade: pale cores to 216/169/94; warm R<=208, G<=0.82R, B raised toward 0.30R within G

timing: Four frames over 18 recovery ticks plus local freeze, same index as parry/clash (draw()).
